title: Women Worry, Men Adopt: How Gendered Perceptions Shape the Use of Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing nationally representative UK survey data (2023-2024) using age-stratified random forest models and a synthetic-twin panel design to measure disparities in frequent generative AI adoption between men and women, specifically isolating the impact of societal risk perceptions.

Evaluating variations in generative AI adoption and risk perception across different age cohorts (18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65-74, 75+) to measure generational divides and their intersectional effects with gender and digital literacy.
